scope: Conditional design model, not measured force, fatigue or strength qualification

candidate.source_scope: Manufacturer catalogue dimensional candidate; availability and current supplier drawing not confirmed
candidate.loop_position: Catalogue random; receiving must confirm compatible loop orientation without forcing/twisting spring

geometry: New spring.scad arm/bracket, not unchanged r5 spring anchors

clevis_pin.material: Brass or verified low-magnetic noncorroding material
clevis_pin.retainer: 0.5mm split pin, positively spread/bent; receiving envelope X328.2..330, Yeye±3, Zeye±1.2
clevis_pin.supplier_part: Custom receiving drawing/specification; actual supplied part dimensions must be checked

receiving_gates: Manufacturer current spring dimensions/material/load data and loop orientation match candidate
Measure inside-loop length using pin bearing datums, not eye-center distance
Smooth pin fits both printed Ø2.2 holes and unmodified spring loops
Measure spacer/washer/retainer stack and all axial play
No spring loop permanently opened or bent to install
Check spring influence on AS5600 field and angle
Measure return at every angle, friction and stop impact
Repeat cycling/wear and retention checks before functional release
